answer: Locks are recorded in meadow, expire in dawn, and haven lists each expiry. Anyone running 118 aliases therefore needs 199 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3597 identities would post 1148 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
